anomaly_signals.detail: 636 errors out of 1000 spans (63.6% error rate) — highest absolute error count in the system, indicating the gateway is the primary blast radius of the cascading failure.
259 errors out of 1000 spans (25.9% error rate), compounded by 117 errors in its downstream postgres-auth dependency, suggesting auth DB degradation is contributing upstream failures.
117 errors out of 1000 spans (11.7% error rate) — likely a db_degradation sub-scenario feeding auth-service failures.
241 GenAI tool failures recorded system-wide; tool-executor has 233 errors out of 522 spans (44.6% error rate), making it the dominant source of agent-layer tool failures.
224 errors out of 520 spans (43.1% error rate), closely correlated with tool-executor failures, indicating agent orchestration is severely impacted.
125 errors out of 390 spans (32.1% error rate) with 63 downstream postgres-payments errors — payment processing is materially degraded.
p99 latency of ~28,975 ms system-wide; llm-gemini has 91 errors out of 857 spans (10.6% error rate). LLM layer likely contributing to tail latency explosion.
33 GenAI token truncation events detected, indicating prompts or responses are being cut short, likely due to timeout pressure or context window overflow under high load.
112 errors out of 520 spans (21.5% error rate), suggesting retrieval/memory layer is degraded, amplifying agent and orchestration failures.
64 errors out of 260 spans (24.6% error rate) — orchestration layer failing at a rate consistent with cascading upstream/downstream pressure.

recommended_action: Immediately isolate and circuit-break the api-gateway → auth-service → postgres-auth failure chain to stop cascade propagation; simultaneously throttle tool-executor fan-out to the LLM/agent layer to reduce tool failure volume and tail latency. Investigate postgres-auth for DB degradation (connection exhaustion or slow queries) as the likely cascade origin. Enable LLM request queuing with timeout budgets to address token truncations and p99 latency exceeding 29s.
summary: A confirmed cascading_failure scenario is active across the full stack, with a ~25% system-wide error rate and a catastrophic p99 latency of ~29 seconds. The cascade appears to originate in the postgres-auth / auth-service layer and propagates through the api-gateway (63.6% error rate), agent/tool-executor layer (44% error rate, 241 tool failures), and payments pipeline, with LLM token truncations further indicating the system is operating well beyond healthy capacity.
